d: Dipavli milan samaroh ke dauran pradhanmantri narendr modi ne viksit bharat ke sankalp par jor dete hue kaha ki aaj desh varsh 2047 ki samay-sima ko dhyan men rakhkar aage barh raha hai aur is lakshy ko hasil karne ke lie samuhik prayas kie ja rahe hain. vahin, janjatiy gaurav divas ko lekar bhajpa ki or se vyapak karyakramon ka aayojan kiya ja raha hai. purv kendriy mantri arjun munda ne kaha ki kendr sarkar aadivasi samaj ke samman, adhikar aur vikas ke lie pratibaddh hai. unhonne kangres par aadivasi samaj ko lekar keval vot baink ki rajniti karne ka aarop lagaya. idhar, nisha bhagat ki…
